title: Left-hand fingering on a C-major arpeggio
description: Four quarter notes climbing a C-major arpeggio in open position, each annotated with its string and the conventional left-hand finger: C3 (string 5, finger 3), E3 (string 4, finger 2), G3 (string 3, open — no fingering, because open strings need none), C4 (string 2, finger 1). Fingering is flat on the note (a peer of string, not tab-scoped — piano wants it too) with hand + finger. The renderer does not draw fingering yet; the goldens pin that the annotations are carried without disturbing either staff.
